sources.qualified_semantics: asyncio.Task.cancel requests cancellation and does not guarantee cancellation; cancelled() becomes true only when the wrapped coroutine actually propagates CancelledError and is cancelled.
std::jthread::request_stop issues a stop request against a shared stop-state; it is a request-state transition, not proof that the thread has finished.
std::jthread::join blocks until the identified thread finishes, providing a distinct completion/quiescence boundary after a stop request.
